definitions.explanation: A cup with graduated markings used to measure ingredients by volume, especially in cooking and baking.

examples.japanese: {計量|けいりょう}カップ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{量|はか}る→量る：28293_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: Measure water with a measuring cup.

examples.japanese: {計量|けいりょう}カップ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{目分量|めぶんりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I didn't have a measuring cup, so I added it by eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{計量|けいりょう}カップ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦カップ→カップ：01077_kappu⟧⟦{量|はか}って→量る：28293_hakaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please measure out two cups of flour with a measuring cup, as the recipe says.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{計量|けいりょう}→計量：14797_keiryou⟧ (measuring) + ⟦カップ→カップ：01077_kappu⟧ (cup). A standard kitchen tool in Japan. Note that the Japanese {一|いっ}⟦カップ→カップ：01077_kappu⟧ (one cup) in cooking is 200ml, which differs from the US cup (approximately 240ml).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計量|けいりょう}カップ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{量|はか}る→量る：28293_hakaru⟧: measure with a measuring cup
- {計量|けいりょう}カップ⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧: one measuring cup full
- ⟦{耐熱|たいねつ}→耐熱：21127_tainetsu⟧{計量|けいりょう}カップ: heat-resistant measuring cup

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{大|おお}さじ→大さじ：22527_oosaji⟧: tablespoon (measurement)
- ⟦{小|こ}さじ→小さじ：12435_kosaji⟧: teaspoon (measurement)
